blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

South Surrey acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for a detached house in South Surrey was $1,612,500 in September 2026. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.
South Surrey houses with acreage sold, November 2025 to October 2026

12 houses with acreage sold in South Surrey with a median price of $2,700,000 (the middle half sold between $2,227,500 and $3,255,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 91.3% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median year built of 1978 and a median lot of 1.01 acres.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: South Surrey real estate market stats

faq.q: What did acreages in South Surrey sell for?
faq.a: 12 houses with acreage sold in South Surrey between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,700,000.

faq.q: How long do acreages take to sell in South Surrey?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 91.3% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most acreages in South Surrey sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 12 houses with acreage that sold in South Surrey went for between $2,227,500 and $3,255,000, around a median of $2,700,000.

faq.q: Do acreages in South Surrey sell above asking price?
faq.a: 8% of the 12 houses with acreage sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 91.3% of it.

faq.q: How old are the acreages that sold in South Surrey?
faq.a: The median year built was 1978 for the 12 houses with acreage sold in South Surrey.

faq.q: Is South Surrey a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in South Surrey had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in South Surrey?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in South Surrey that match what you want.
